description: One registered name per TOML precision. Each recipe gives the runner selector, the catalog label, per-module rules (default fp16; the most specific component/role/layer rule wins), the profiles that realize it, the profile limits it implies and the cold switches it sets. A bound profile's group_size limit must equal the W4 rule groups. Norms, embeddings and caches are outside the rules. A new mix is added here only together with the owner that runs it.
